mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND app_key = #{appKey} AND deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission != '' AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1
SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}
